//: Deadlines the upgrade lane cannot execute, each naming the unit proof that does — KEYED ON THE RAMP'S DETAIL since 1.0.0 (the same per-site identity the obligations ramp union adopted at 0.11.0). The lane's §7 narrow() keeps only gates in the validate chain, so a gate outside it whose ramp EXPIRES is dropped from the expectation set — its RAMP EXPIRED branch fires in no lane, structurally. An entry here is the reviewed compensating control: `detail` is a substring that must match EXACTLY ONE of the gate's shipped rampNote details (upgrade-lane.sh §7e re-derives the dropped sites from scripts/lib/ramp-sites.mjs and binds each to its entry), `proof` is the test file that drives the REAL gate to that ramp's RAMP EXPIRED exit on a fixture, and §7e asserts the proof file carries BOTH the literal 'RAMP EXPIRED' and the detail substring — the banner must name ITS OWN ramp, which is the closure the 0.11.0 axe finding was missing: check-web-e2e.test.mjs carried four RAMP EXPIRED mentions, all driving the 0.6.0 ramp, so the 0.10.0 axe expiry would have been excused by a proof of an unrelated deadline. `note` says why the lane cannot execute the gate. §7e dies on a dropped expiry with no matching entry, on an entry naming a gate this leg's chain runs, and on an entry whose detail matches no shipped site (stale).
